entries.reason: write(to:) is declared and refuses with MLCreateErrorCode.cannotWriteModel, case 6, whose text is `The model cannot be written from this build or platform`. Apple's own write(to:metadata:) writes a model for a decision tree on every release that has it, so this refuses where Apple's would work and the row is `absent`, not `implemented`. It is absent because the model is a different kind of object: a `TreeEnsembleRegressor` (field 302) with one branch of one tree, and the writer in this package's CoreML module writes a NeuralNetworkRegressor. A file that said NeuralNetworkRegressor and carried one of those would be a model Core ML loads and answers with the wrong arithmetic, which is worse than one that says it cannot. The error it gives is in facts/CreateML/Export.md
entries.source: the SDK's own interface; the refusal is the port's and its test checks that it refuses
